summary: Three pages. (1) Math-Drills 'Multiplication Facts to 100 (A)': she did the Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday columns (20 facts each), timing herself 43, 48 and 31 seconds, and left Thursday and Friday blank. 58 of 60 look right; 8 × 7 is written 55 (should be 56), and the last 7 × 10 looks like 20 (should be 70, the writing is cramped). Both slips are in the 7s/8s. (2) Reading page 'Turkey for Thanksgiving' (story about Travis the wild turkey). (3) Its question sheet: three short answers in full, correct sentences (central message: unexpected things can turn out good; 'a mission that went sideways' means his plan to escape hunters did not go as planned and he became a pet; point of view: Travis the turkey's) and three true/false, all correct (hamburgers True, girl showed kindness True, hid in an old hay barn False - it was a shed). Nothing is marked by a teacher on the pages. She backs her answers with the story rather than guessing.

progress: The facts sheet was timed again and is strong overall (31 seconds is her best); the errors are on 7s and 8s facts, which matches where facts slip elsewhere. Reading answers are complete and accurate, which fits her recap reading answers.
